caption: The video captures a fixed close-up of a hydraulic press, with a polished metal piston head hovering above a short cylindrical anvil painted with yellow-and-black hazard stripes. A heap of white shattered fragments rests on the anvil's top face, and many more shards litter the surrounding metal table. Initially, a cloud of white pieces is already airborne between the raised head and the heap, settling onto the pile within the first moments. Striped guard columns flank the scene and a small action camera sits at the far left, all stationary. The piston head descends slowly and continuously. This steady travel narrows the gap above the mostly still white pile on the anvil. Toward the end, the head continues downward until its underside is very close to the heap, while a few loose fragments drift and fall away at the pile's edges.
